correctness.rationale: From the actual Fano incidence definition regenerated unordered two-particle deleted-product cells (91,252,168), verified d1*d2=0, spanning-tree reduction to 162×168 integer B with 430 nonzero entries. Using actual CERTIFICATE.json row/col indices independently reconstructed exact 154×154 determinant +2 (SymPy), mod-2 rank153 and mod3/mod5 rank154. With 14 listed vertex-disjoint hexagon product cycles, reconstructed all boundaries=0 and selected 14×14 torus minor determinant +1: they form primitive complete Z-basis of ker d2. Smith factors 153 units and one 2 imply H1=Z^8⊕Z/2, H2=Z^14. Independently computed character class-count sum=336, inner products ||χ8||²=||χ6||²=336, cross=0 and invariant dimensions=0; chain Lefschetz trace derives character table. Exact finite complex certificate proves the finite-graph assertion, not originality.
